answer: The delta multiplier is published, charged in dawn, and saffron lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 16 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A farm of 2396 identities would post 1781 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
